banner:
Digital Experience Monitoring

See how real users experience your app

From the outside in: uptime and speed, from anywhere. From the inside out: real sessions and real errors. One setup covers both.

Start with Set up both. You enter your app's URL once, and it starts an uptime check and gets the Frontend Observability snippet ready in about two minutes. Prefer to set them up separately? Pick one of the other two guides.

rules.title: Set up both
rules.description: Enter your app's URL, start a Synthetic Monitoring uptime check on it, and get the Frontend Observability snippet for the same origin. Requires Editor access.

rules.title: Synthetic Monitoring only
rules.description: Create a ping check, pick probe locations, and read uptime, reachability, and latency on its dashboard. Requires Editor access.

rules.title: Frontend Observability only
rules.description: Create a Frontend Observability application and get the Faro Web SDK snippet that sends real user data.
